brief:
Adam Hamawy, a former army surgeon who volunteered in Gaza, has become the first Muslim American elected to the US Congress from New Jersey, Al Jazeera English reported. Hamawy's campaign centered on healthcare advocacy, adopting the slogan "Healthcare not bombs" as he challenged incumbent representatives on war and public health priorities.

His path to Congress was shaped by medical work in Gaza, where he witnessed conditions that steered his political focus toward domestic health policy and opposition to military spending abroad. The election marks a milestone for Muslim American representation in the New Jersey congressional delegation.
dek: Former army surgeon and Gaza volunteer Hamawy is the first Muslim American elected to the US Congress from New Jersey.
title: Gaza volunteer Hamawy elected first Muslim American to Congress from New Jersey
